description:
You got the inspection done. 𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐝. ✅

But the 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐯𝐚𝐥𝐮𝐞 isn’t the report.
It’s the conversation you have while the inspector is still standing in the house. 🏡🗣️

Do not just wait for the report to land in your email.
This is your chance to get 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 that can save you 𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐲, 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞, and 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 later. 💰⏳😮‍💨

𝐀𝐬𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐞 👇

1️⃣ 𝐈𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐲, 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐛𝐮𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞?
It’s a bold question, but their reaction tells you everything. 👀
A good inspector won’t decide for you, but you can read between the lines real quick.

2️⃣ 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐱𝐞𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐯𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐰𝐚𝐢𝐭?
Every home has flaws.
You’re not looking for perfect.
You’re looking for safe, functional, and smart. 🛠️
This helps separate dealbreakers from future projects.

3️⃣ 𝐈𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐬𝐤 𝐟𝐨𝐫?
Inspectors see hundreds of homes.
They know what’s reasonable to request and what might push a seller away.
That insight helps your agent negotiate smarter. 🤝🧠

Especially if you’re buying from out of state —
having the right guidance during inspection matters.
